ops.body: Criterion 3ab62b7 note: default remains advisory-only; the plan-approved --fix removal was added on top, gated by the full orphan predicate evaluated twice (scan + immediately pre-removal re-confirm of row/dirs/DomainRoot) so a live or in-flight domain is never removed — negative table cases pin healthy-account, in-flight-add, unreadable-state, and app-unavailable to no-removal. Shipped v0.49.0 (77f03928).
